name: KeepDwell Home Repair & Maintenance Cost Dataset
description: US homeowner repair and maintenance cost ranges compiled from KeepDwell's published guides. Each row is one costed item from one guide, with the guide's own cost text, parsed USD low/high where the text states figures, and a link to the source guide.
